messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: inference-runtime service — elevated KV cache miss rate and tail latency spike. Impact: ~5% request errors (502) and p99 latency >2s. Pager routed to eng-oncall.
alex: on it, pulling recent deploys and logs.
sam: I see a quantized model rollout at 03:14 UTC (deploy id deploy-2026-03-17-qlt) — correlates with the spike.
maria: customer reports from acme-corp and beta-team started ~03:12 UTC, tickets coming in about timeouts/slow responses.
rita: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kvcache-miss — follow standard triage. tagging @alex @sam
alex: running quick grep to confirm kv miss lines:
```bash
kubectl logs -l app=inference-runtime --since=15m | grep -i "KVCACHE_MISS" | wc -l
```
sam: results: miss rate jumped ~2% -> 48% in 3m window, batching queues backed up causing tail latency.
alex: suggested mitigation: rollback the quantized variant (fastest) OR increase kvcache capacity + force warmup. rollback safer.
rita: rollback command: `rd-deploy rollback deploy-2026-03-17-qlt --to deploy-2026-03-16` — I can run if you want.
sam: starting rollback now, monitoring traffic and metrics.
incident-bot: deploy rollback started by sam (deploy-2026-03-17-qlt -> deploy-2026-03-16).
sam: rollback confirmed succeeded. Traffic shifted.
maria: customers reporting improvement on tickets — initial confirmation from ACME: latency normalized.
alex: metrics now: p99 from 2.4s -> 0.6s, error rate down to baseline.
rita: great. Next: schedule postmortem + action items. Propose postmortem tomorrow 10:00 PT. Anyone else drive? :spiral_calendar_pad:
sam: I will lead the postmortem and own the draft.
alex: action items I want recorded now: 1) Add stronger preflight validation and gating for quantized model rollouts (owner: sam, due: 2026-03-24). 2) Add KVCACHE_MISS alert with threshold and escalation (owner: rita, due: 2026-03-20). 3) Canary-size policy for quant + batching interaction — limit rollout to 1% traffic then step up (owner: alex, due: 2026-04-01). 4) Update runbook with explicit rollback + cache-warmup checklist (owner: maria, due: 2026-03-22).
tay: adding these to sprint board and tagging owners.
sam: also: quick follow-up experiment — on-deploy kvcache warmup job to populate caches before traffic shift. Tracked in PR #4567.
alex: note for remediation: investigate why quant variant increases miss amplification under our batching behavior (likely model footprint + kv eviction pattern).
rita: I'll add a short playbook entry: how to force fallback to baseline model in the router config (`router.override_model: baseline`) and validate traffic.
kevin: handing overnight monitoring — I'll watch the dashboards and set a quiet-hours alert window. acknowledged.
alex: handing off to @kevin for overnight. please watch: kvcache_miss_rate, batching_queue_length, p99_latency, error_rate.
kevin: acknowledged. will escalate if metrics breach.
rita: schedule: postmortem invite sent to infra/eng-ml/platform + support. jira ticket RWD-INC-2345 created and linked.
maria: I'll file the incident writeup and link logs/graphs.
sam: postmortem owners: sam (lead), alex (runtime dev notes), rita (alerts/runbook), maria (customer impact summary).
incident-bot: incident state: RESOLVED -> monitoring.
alex: closing bridge. If anyone sees recurrence, react in this thread and @kevin. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
